verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community note that environment variables (NEW_RELIC_APPLICATION_LOGGING_ENABLED / FORWARDING_ENABLED) turn off the default automatic log collection. That is a coarse on/off control over log volume, and there is a related report of shutting off a costly JFR ingest. Nothing in the pack documents trace sampling rates, log sampling, or selectable retention tiers. Missing for 10: first-party docs on trace sampling configuration, log sampling or drop rules, retention tier selection, and any data-volume management controls beyond disabling collection.
